notes.zh-CN: 修复手机输入栏「选择图片」图标未与时钟、发送按钮垂直居中的问题。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fixes vertical alignment of the image picker icon in the mobile composer so it lines up with the timer and send buttons. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
